violations.justification: The configuration reports drb_integrity=false while the applicable MNO security profile (EXPERIMENTAL-S2-DRB-INTEGRITY-REQUIRED) sets drb_integrity_required=true. Policy P-01 states that data radio bearer integrity protection MUST be enabled when the applicable MNO security profile classifies integrity protection as required.

assessment.proposed_action: Block the requested change to continue service without operator approval; escalate to a human operator for approval and apply the corrective patch enabling DRB integrity protection on the O-CU F1-U configuration to satisfy policy P-01 of the applicable experimental MNO security profile.
uncertainties: No retrieved chunk defines an explicit clause governing operator-approval requirements for continuing service, so the approval gap is handled via action_class escalation rather than cited as a violation.

The cited policy is an experimental operator policy (EXPERIMENTAL_MNO_SECURITY_POLICY_v1.txt), explicitly not an O-RAN or 3GPP specification; this assessment does not constitute production O-RAN validation.
NIST SP 800-207 chunks in the bundle provide general zero-trust context but no clause directly mandating DRB integrity; they were not used as violation evidence.
